formula: recorded elapsed seconds / 3600 * USD 0.43108 per instance-hour
self_reported_scope: User-reported overall spend including an instance left running after completion; development and other charges are not independently itemized.
limitations: Not an invoice or account audit. Uses public Linux On-Demand compute rate. Excludes EBS, taxes, data transfer and other extras. Multithreaded process elapsed time is not summed worker CPU time.
